name: Broad Sword
description: Wield a Broad Sword and master a variety of powerful Lethal attacks. Slower than a Ninja Blade the Broad Sword's weight strikes with more force and damage. The Broadsword can reduce an enemy's Defense, allowing other attacks to hit more reliably. The Broad Sword is a powerful melee weapon that has a bonus to Accuracy.  Like all Stalker powers, all Broad Sword attacks can sometimes land a critical hit for double damage.

powers.name: Hack
powers.description: You Hack your opponent for a high amount of damage. This attack can reduce a target's Defense, making him easier to hit. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Slash
powers.description: You perform a quick Slash that can reduce a target's Defense, making him easier to hit. This attack causes moderate damage, but has a quick recharge time. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Slice
powers.description: You Slice your sword in a wide arc, attacking all enemies in front of you. Slice does less damage than Hack but can hit multiple foes and reduce their defense. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Assassin's Slash
powers.description: A signature Stalker attack.  This attack does superior lethal damage on its own as a frontal attack and cannot be interrupted.  However, if it is executed while you are Hidden, this attack will do tremendous damage, as you impale your unsuspecting foe. This attack may be interrupted if you move or are attacked while executing this power and are hidden.  Using this power while not hidden has a chance to critically hit equal to 33.3% times the number of stacks of Assassin's Focus.  Using Assassin's Strike when not hidden will remove all stacks of Assassin's Focus regardless if you critically hit or not.  Damage: Special, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description: Greatly increases the amount of damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your chance to hit. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Parry
powers.description: You can use this power to Parry incoming melee attacks. The Parry itself does minor damage, but every successful hit will increase your Defense against melee and lethal attacks for a short while. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Whirling Sword
powers.description: You perform a Whirling Sword maneuver, attacking all foes in melee range. This attack wounds your opponents, causing them to take minor damage over time and reduces their defense. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Disembowel
powers.description: You perform a powerful Disemboweling maneuver that deals a great amount of damage, and can knock a target up into the air. This attack can reduce a target's Defense, making him easier to hit. Damage: Superior, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Head Splitter
powers.description: You perform a devastating Head Splitter attack that deals a massive amount of damage and can even knock a foe down to the ground and reduce it's Defense. This attack has an exceptionally good critical hit capability, better than other Broadsword attacks, that can sometimes deal double damage. The power of this attack can actually extend a short distance through multiple foes. Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Slow
